title: Plant-Inspired AI: Plants as Inspiration for Novel Problem Formulations, and Two Case Studies
abstract: arXiv:2608.29356v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has long been inspired by studies of biological intelligence. Reinforcement learning, for instance, drew inspiration from studies involving animal learning and is now a powerful paradigm for solving many real-world problems. Recently, plant biologists have uncovered a wide range of complex behaviors in plants that enable them to flexibly adapt to variable environments. Here, we argue that such behavior can motivate new AI frameworks encompassing a range of problems overlooked by existing problem-solving frameworks such as supervised learning, tree search, and constraint satisfaction. We illustrate this idea with two examples of intelligent problem-solving in plants: (1) leaf mimicry in Boquila trifoliolata, a vine capable of altering its leaves' morphology to resemble those of multiple host trees simultaneously; and (2) coordinated root-shoot growth, wherein plants allocate resources across organ systems expl

translated_title: 植物启发的AI：植物作为新颖问题表述的灵感来源及两个案例研究
translated_abstract: 人工智能（AI）长期以来一直受到生物智能研究的启发。例如，强化学习的灵感源自对动物学习的研究，如今已成为解决许多现实世界问题的强大范式。近年来，植物生物学家发现植物具有广泛的复杂行为，使其能够灵活地适应多变的环境。在此，我们提出，这些行为可以启发新的AI框架，涵盖现有问题求解框架（如监督学习、树搜索和约束满足）所忽视的一系列问题。我们用两个植物智能问题求解的例子来说明这一想法：（1）三叶假藤的叶片拟态，这种藤本植物能够改变叶片形态，同时模拟多种宿主树木的叶子；（2）根-茎协调生长，即植物在器官系统之间分配资源，探索（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出植物的复杂适应行为可以启发超越监督学习、树搜索等现有范式的新型AI问题表述框架，并以三叶假藤的叶片拟态和根-茎协调生长两个案例加以论证。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that complex plant behaviors can inspire novel AI problem formulations beyond existing frameworks like supervised learning and tree search, illustrated through two case studies: leaf mimicry in Boquila trifoliolata and coordinated root-shoot growth.
